lines: Was said in Jñānottara, and that this by Supreme Lord: Śiva sacrifice-
loving, from which especially in mothers' midst.
l4.sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ jñānottarāyāṃ ca tadetatparameśinā śivo yāgapriyo yasmādviśeṣānmātṛmadhyagaḥ
